notes: Things people say when they act. Jev picks the action and the line together, so the voice fits the person. Tones: frightened, angry, protective (the victim is family), official (guards), shrewd (merchants and calculating types). Slots: {victim}, {relation} (e.g. 'my nephew'), {guard}, {item}, {owner}, {weapon}. A person never repeats their last line.

frightened: I want no part of this!
shrewd: Not my fight. Not my fight at all.

angry: Guards! Get over here! This one attacked {victim}!
official: Alarm! To me, all of you!
Guards to the smithy road! Now!

frightened: Stay back from that one, he hurt {victim}!
angry: Watch yourselves, that one lashes out!
shrewd: I'd keep my distance from our new friend if I were you.

angry: {guard}, the stranger {short}. I saw it myself.
official: Captain's orders or not, {guard}, the stranger {short}.
shrewd: {guard}, a word. The stranger {short}. Thought you'd want to know.
{guard}. You'll want to hear this: the stranger {short}.

angry: What do you think you're doing?!
official: You there. Stand where you are and explain yourself.
By order of the gate: account for yourself.
shrewd: Now then. That was unwise. What's your game?
Interesting. Care to tell me why?

angry: Touch anyone else and I'll break your arm.
One more step and you'll regret it.
official: Hands where I can see them, stranger.
protective: Come near {relation} again and I'll finish you.
Back away from {relation}. I won't say it twice.

official: In the captain's name, down you go!

angry: That's my {item}. Give it back or pay for it.
shrewd: That {item} is mine. Coin, or I call the guard.
You'll pay for that {item}. With interest.

official: *a sharp whistle* To me! Trouble on the road!

frightened: {victim}! Oh gods, are you all right?
protective: Look at me, {victim}. You'll be all right.
